Player guide

ARRIVE READY. ENJOY THE GAME.

A practical guide to your next visit to the club.

1

Before you arrive

Confirm your session time and check what equipment is available. Tell the team about your experience and whether you are coming with a partner.

2

On court

Use suitable court footwear, keep the playing area clear and take a moment to agree how you will play with your group. Ask the team if a court detail is unfamiliar.

3

After the game

Return any borrowed equipment and leave the court ready for the next players. If you want to come back, ask which session fits your next step.

GOOD QUESTIONS BEFORE A GOOD GAME.

Can I change my session?

+

Contact the club with your session details as soon as your plans change. The team will explain the options for your booking.

Can I arrive on my own?

+

Ask about coaching and social sessions. Sharing your level helps the team discuss a suitable way to join.

Can we bring a mixed-level group?

+

Yes, begin by describing the group and what you want from the visit. The team can discuss a format that makes sense for everyone.
